sections.text:
-Target: all allies. Healing Ability Power 60. Heals HP.
Healing Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Removes debuffs.
-Target: all allies. Increases physical and magic attack Ability Power by 30 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 30 Cost.
-Target: yourself. Applies frenzy (nullifies debuffs, nullifies status ailments, permits piercing through damage reduction and damage reflection) for 60 seconds.
